column4: Republic Act No. 9165 (Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002)
column6: Section 36(c). Authorized Drug Testing for Students. — Authorized drug testing shall be done by any government forensic laboratories or by any of the drug testing laboratories accredited and monitored by the Department of Health (DOH) to safeguard the quality of test results. Students of secondary and tertiary schools shall, pursuant to the related rules and regulations as contained in the school's student handbook and with notice to the parents, undergo a random drug testing: Provided, That all drug testing expenses whether in public or private schools under this Section will be borne by the government.
column7: City Ordinance No. 0521-17, Series of 2017 (The Davao City Student Health Protection and Drug-Free Campus Intervention Code)
column9: SECTION 6. CONFIDENTIALITY OF REHABILITATION RECORDS. — Pursuant to the constitutional priority accorded to education and the municipal youth development mandate of Davao City, positive drug screening results obtained during school random testing protocols shall remain strictly confidential, treated as medical records to guide therapeutic intervention without entry into police records. The City Education Development Division and the Local School Board shall monitor institutional compliance and submit quarterly reports to the Sangguniang Panlungsod.
column10: City Ordinance No. 0521-17, Series of 2017 (The Davao City Student Health Protection and Drug-Free Campus Intervention Code)

column4: Republic Act No. 11314 (Student Fare Discount Act)
column6: Section 5. Student Fare Discount Privilege. — A student under this Act shall be entitled to a grant for twenty percent (20%) discount on the regular domestic transportation utility fares for land, rail, sea and air, upon presentation of their duly issued school identification cards or valid enrollment documents. The discount shall be granted across all public transportation utilities operating within Philippine territory throughout the entire calendar year.
column7: City Ordinance No. 0772-22, Series of 2022 (The Davao City Student Transportation Fare Discount Privilege and Mobility Accessibility Code)
column9: SECTION 5. ENFORCEMENT ACROSS ALL CALENDAR DAYS. — In coordination with the Department of Education and the Commission on Higher Education under local ordinance powers, the City Transport and Traffic Management Office (CTTMO) shall enforce student fare discounts continuously across all days of the year, including weekends, semestral breaks, and national holidays. The City Health Office and the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) shall deploy inspection officers to ensure student protection standards.
column10: City Ordinance No. 0772-22, Series of 2022 (The Davao City Student Transportation Fare Discount Privilege and Mobility Accessibility Code)

column6: Section 4.
